research_question: Did entry into national emissions trading increase carbon-market-related content in annual reports of non-power firms with captive generation?
treatment: Exact full legal listed-company name or same-name branch on official December 2020 national 2019-2020 allocation roster; chemical, paper and coal industries only.
control: Same three industries, no roster match in source archive, no direct exact match, no known pilot-exchange record through 2020; absence of a subsidiary match remains a validation requirement.
exclude: Power companies, steel/cement/metals expansion sectors; pilot headquarters Beijing Tianjin Shanghai Chongqing Hubei Guangdong Fujian; prior pilot-exchange records; unknown 2019 headquarters; ambiguous indirect ownership matches.
timing: Roster published December 2020; national trading began July 2021. FY2020 annual reports filed in 2021 are transitional and excluded from primary estimation. Pre: FY2017-2019 reports filed before December 2020. Post: FY2021-2023 reports filed after national launch. FY2019-2020 retrospective compliance labels are NOT adoption dates.
primary_outcome: Any carbon-market-related page under source restricted dictionary plus entity-name filter. This is content presence, not accuracy, general CSR or physical emissions.
primary_sample: Companies with all 3 pre and 3 post reports observed; missing PDF or extraction is missing, never zero. Report date and extractable-text checks required. Unbalanced same-company sample is sensitivity.
primary_model: Firm, sector-year and province-year fixed effects; treatment x post; no post-treatment financial controls; province-cluster CR1 t and restricted wild-cluster bootstrap, 9999 draws, seed 20261113. Report firm-cluster sensitivity.
event_study: Year-specific treatment interactions, FY2019 reference, FY2020 excluded; pre coefficients FY2017 and FY2018; simultaneous confidence band and joint test. Passing a p-value test is not proof of parallel trends.
sensitivity: Pre-treatment assets, leverage and ROA interacted with year; sector-specific estimates; no leave-one-out selection; restricted dictionary versus name-filter; count log1p; all results retained. Trend deviation robustness uses a stated annual differential drift budget.
measurement_validation: Replicate archive strict-page counts for a fixed validation sample selected before outcome inspection; report all disagreements; inspect flagged passages. Extend FY2017-2018 directly from CNINFO filings using unchanged dictionaries.
decision: No causal wording if treatment validation fails, source extraction disagreement materially changes outcomes, no pre-period support, clear pre-trend violation, or inference excludes economically meaningful effects only under favorable specification. Report estimates irrespective of sign/significance.
notes: Prior broad country associations and source-data descriptions were already inspected; this is an internal prospective record for a new design, not an original randomized experiment. The source archive's 2024 expansion and its one-pass FE estimator are not adopted.
